recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Any future desire to define observation qualifiers more formally or to add stronger hasMember/component rules should be handled as a new OO work-group decision, not as a FHIR-14392 reconciliation fix.
issue_request: FHIR-14392 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for STU3 Observation asking the spec to clarify that Observation.component can contain either separate individual parts of an observation or qualifying information for Observation.code, and that Observation code/value plus component code/value pairs must all be considered to understand the observation.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit 0b2b3d039c (GF#14392), which added the qualifying-information guidance to source/observation/observation-notes.xml and added interpretation comments to the old Observation spreadsheet. Those spreadsheet comments are now present in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml after source migration.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Observation notes state that component observations may be separate individual parts or qualifying information to Observation.code and that all code-value and component.code-component.value pairs need to be considered. The current StructureDefinition comments for Observation.code and Observation.component.code retain the same interpretation rule, and Observation.component points readers to the notes. Later FHIR-51724 was Resolved - No Change after quoting the current component notes as sufficient for component/hasMember clarity. Zulip searches found direct and later discussion of qualifier use; Confluence searches found no FHIR-14392 references or conflicting decisions.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active current source already conveys the resolved FHIR-14392 rule through the Observation notes and element comments, and adding another restatement to Observation.component would be redundant rather than a necessary correction.

related_jiras.note: Later OO Resolved - No Change issue quoted the current Observation.component notes as already covering the requested distinction between component and hasMember.
